lines.text: Many learners say: Young people tend using phones a lot.
Better: Young people tend to use phones a lot.
Tend is followed by to and the base verb.
To be! He tends to be late.

data.wrong: Young people tend using phones a lot.
data.right: Young people tend to use phones a lot.
data.why: Tend is followed by to and the base verb.
